response.rationale: A and B are different concepts. A is the Treatment Product, the catalogue entry for a product. TreatmentProductRepository stores these as TreatmentProductRecord entries (src/persistence/repositories.ts: "private readonly items = new Map<string, TreatmentProductRecord>();"). B is a Treatment, a single event where a treatment is applied to a hive. In src/business/reportService.ts, ReportService looks these up per hive: "for (const t of this.treatments.findByHive(hive.id)) {". The graph backs this up. ReportService (node a663bd12cbc0090c) calls two separate repositories, TreatmentRepository.findByHive and TreatmentProductRepository.findAll, so the codebase models them as two distinct things. TreatmentService also has its own addProduct/listProducts methods, separate from recordTreatment. A treatment probably refers to a product it uses, but the event and the product are different real-world things that just share part of a name.
